title: 613 (City Of Manchester) Squadron
memorial_details: description: 613 (CITY OF MANCHESTER) SQUADRON /ROYAL AUXILIARY AIR FORCE /WAS FORMED HERE AT RINGWAY /ON 1st MARCH 1939 /This Commemorative Stone /Is Dedicated To All Those Who /Served With The Squadron /And Is A Memorial To /Those Who Gave Their Lives/ 1939 - 1957 /OPERATIONAL AIRCRAFT /HIND                       MUSTANG /HECTOR               MOSQUITO /LYSANDER                 SPITFIRE /TOMAHAWK                    VAMPIRE
